pills.label: In 14:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 14:00, an hour earlier than most hotels on this list, and check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card are asked for at check-in, and the hotel wants your arrival time in advance.

pills.label: 35 m² Deluxe
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: The Deluxe Room (377 ft², king or twin) comes with a bath, a bluetooth speaker and free pool and beach access at Le Royal Meridien. The marble bathrooms have Byredo amenities, a soaking tub and a rain shower.

pills.label: Free cots
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children of any age are welcome, and those 12 and over pay as adults. Cots for under-2s are free; an extra bed for 12+ costs AED 360 a night. The hotel is wheelchair accessible, with grab rails and a raised toilet.

pills.label: Free beach access
pills.pop_html: Beach: Guests get full use of the beach, pools and leisure facilities at sister hotel Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa, with a free shuttle. The Beach Mall is a 10-minute walk.

pills.label: Breakfast deals
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: Breakfast-included rates for the Deluxe Room start at €285 a night, with free cancellation and pay at the property. Breakfast here is rated "superb" by guests.

pills.label: 10 restaurants
pills.pop_html: Dining: Buddha-Bar, Toro Toro (Latin American), Rhodes W1 (British, with high tea), Indego by Vineet (Indian) and Bar 44 with top-floor Marina views, plus a weekly seafood buffet at Sloane's.

pills.label: Classic luxury
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Butler service, floor-to-ceiling windows and two spas (B/Attitude and Retreat). Guests score cleanliness and comfort 9.8, the highest marks on this page.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the best-reviewed hotel in Dubai Marina, 10 restaurants downstairs and a free beach day at Le Royal Meridien, from €236 a night.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to walk straight from your room onto the sand: the beach is a shuttle ride away, so book the W (#4) instead.

pills.label: 43 m² Classic
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: The Classic King Room is 463 ft² (about 43 m²) with a city view, soundproofing, a minibar and a 40-inch smart TV. That is the most floor space per euro of any regular hotel room on this page.

pills.label: Kids' pool
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children of any age are welcome and only pay as adults from 15. Cots are free for under-2s, extra beds AED 100 a night. Wheelchair accessible, with Braille visual aids.

pills.label: Breakfast €20
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: Add breakfast for €20, or book a breakfast-included rate from €175 (non-refundable). The flexible breakfast rate is €219, with free cancellation and nothing to pay upfront.

pills.label: 2 pools
pills.pop_html: Pools: An outdoor pool with pool bar plus a separate kids' pool, and a spa with 6 treatment suites and a Pilates studio.

pills.label: Rooftop Rex Bar
pills.pop_html: Dining: Accents (all-day, theme nights), Urban Lounge, Ginter gin bar and the rooftop Rex Bar, which serves Italian through the winter season.

pills.label: Marina-front city hotel
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A big, polished business-and-leisure hotel with 328 rooms, facing Dubai Marina Mall on the promenade, with easy access to the Dubai Tram.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and families who want a 5★ room of 43 m² on the Marina promenade for €162, the lowest price of any 5★ hotel here (only the City Premiere apartments cost less).
best_for.skip_html: if beach time is the point of the trip: there is no beach deal, so Grosvenor House (#1) or the W (#4) fit better.

pills.label: Kids' club

pills.label: Direct mall link
pills.pop_html: Location: Directly linked to Dubai Marina Mall and Marina Walk. The beach is a 5-minute stroll, and Media City is 5 minutes by car.

pills.label: Level-4 infinity pool
pills.pop_html: Pools: Heated infinity pool on level 4 with poolside bar and Marina views, plus a separate children's pool.

pills.label: Breakfast €36

pills.label: Polished and lively

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids over 2 who want a kids' club, a children's pool and Dubai Marina Mall on the other side of a corridor.
best_for.skip_html: if you travel with a baby: the hotel lists no cots. Jumeirah Living (#8) gives free cots and extra beds.

pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out between 12:00 and 12:30, the latest standard check-out on this page.

pills.label: 53 m², balcony
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Deluxe King Room with Harbor View and Balcony, 570 ft² (about 53 m²), with walk-in shower and bath. The biggest regular hotel room of the ten.

pills.label: Teens stay as kids
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children only pay as adults from 18, so teens count as children here. Free cots for under-2s, extra beds AED 125 a night. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Beachfront
pills.pop_html: Beach: The only true beachfront hotel on this list, on the Jumeirah Beach coastline. Mina Seyahi Beach is 400 m away and Marina Beach under 1 km.

pills.label: Infinity pool, Palm view
pills.pop_html: Pool: Heated infinity pool with pool bar looking over Palm Jumeirah, and the WET Deck at Ginger Moon with live entertainment.

pills.label: Breakfast or all-inclusive
pills.pop_html: Board: Breakfast €33 extra, or included from €287. It is also the only hotel here with all-inclusive rates, from €471 for two.

pills.label: Party resort
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Billed as a dining and nightlife destination: 7 restaurants and bars including ATTIKO, Bussola and Fish Beach Taverna. Pets welcome (charges may apply).

best_for.pick_html: for couples and friends who want the beach, an infinity pool facing the Palm and a nightlife scene on site, with a 53 m² balcony room for €248.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a quiet stay: it is built around nightlife and live entertainment, and it scores 8.6 for location, the lowest here.

pills.label: World's tallest hotel

pills.label: 3 pools incl. rooftop

pills.label: 8 min to Barasti

pills.label: Sky-high showpiece
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A showpiece tower with 8 restaurants and lounges (Tattu, Nuage, West 13, Koi House) and a spa with sauna. Built for the view and the photo.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a room and a rooftop pool high up in the world's tallest hotel for €191, with Barasti Beach 8 minutes away on foot.
best_for.skip_html: if room size matters: the 27 m² Deluxe is the joint-smallest cheapest room on this page (with Vida, which adds a balcony for €18 less).

pills.label: Free cots

pills.label: Breakfast included

pills.label: Heated pool
pills.pop_html: Pool and wellness: Heated outdoor pool, spa with hot tub and sauna, and a fitness centre.

pills.label: Space to live
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A suites hotel for longer stays: you can cook, do laundry and spread out, then eat at the Observatory when you don't want to.

best_for.skip_html: if you need strong Wi-Fi for work: guests score it 7.9, the lowest Wi-Fi mark here.
